text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Was Sensei watching, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'll show Sensei too. The future 
we lived for.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If your life is to run out this year, then 
I will spend this entire year becoming 
your hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...My temples are throbbing, and behind 
my eyes, it's burning hot.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...The results of the bet are about to be 
announced, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: —Festa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait for me, Doc.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later. In front of the 
hospital—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the doctor's room is one floor 
up from the previous one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yo, Prof—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa... I'm glad... you came...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's sensei smiles gracefully 
and waves her hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if enduring the pain, she moves slowly, 
far below her shoulders, in delicate 
motions. It looks as though she can barely 
even move.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her wrists and neck appeared a full size 
smaller than before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa... I... ...*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: *cough, cough*! *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm, sor... ry. More importantly... I 
have to... Festa..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: *cough*! *hack*...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …………Teach...er?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me! I'll go get the teacher right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (—My vision is turning completely white.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(The nurses were in a panic. Pops's face 
was stiff with tension. And the 
doctor—looked pained.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (—Was this... the outcome?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Was this... the result I was looking 
for?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensei only had one year, didn't he? 
Really only one year... ..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa was completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps this is the first time she's 
faced it. The moment when the light of 
someone close to her is about to go out."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there was any meaning to what 
I did.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could change something. ...I 
was sure I could do something about it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, in the end, what help did I 
actually provide? All while Sensei's "end" 
was drawing nearer by the moment.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In such a limited amount of time... ngh, 
what on earth was I doing...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's totally Nakayama for real. 
What're you doing?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Jordan...? Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Coincidence? Nah, I was at the clinic for 
my nails. Still being treated. Almost 
fully healed though."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Because to me, you've become my dream.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Crap... messed up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
B-Besides! Don't I kinda look totally out 
of place here? Ahh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No it ain't!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "dream" Tosen Jordan let slip— it 
might just be a glimmer of hope for 
Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geh?! Don't follow me!! How could you 
possibly leave Nakayama behind in that 
atmosphere?!
choice_data_list:
Your very existence is proof of Nakayama's 
results!
Your existence is the result of Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Results?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
............ I can't shake the faint 
glimmer of hope that maybe, just maybe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Scraping my head against the dirt, 
clinging to the light seen for a fleeting 
moment.
choice_data_list: I want you to tell them about your dream.
I want you to tell me about your dream.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A dream, you say...?
choice_data_list: What is Nakayama to you, anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...... That is—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...? Jordan? Didn't you already leave...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You're the one who said you'd try your 
best even if there's no point.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're the one who changed me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Did you forget telling me it wasn't 
useless? I decided to give it my all 
because you said that...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
――To put it in your words! I actually 
wanted to "live" properly as the Umamusume 
Tosen Jordan!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I'm just an Umamusume who 
couldn't even challenge for the Triple 
Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even if the people around you are saying 
doubtful things!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
To me, you looked so dazzling. So bright, 
it almost made me jealous.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted to win. So badly it 
hurts."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And now, beating the peer who ran and 
claimed the Triple Crown has become my 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A blue flame flickered within those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Jordan, you...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come on! Take responsibility! You're 
the one who gave me this much hope, 
y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Compete against me as a truly strong 
Umamusume! Face me properly!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Nakayama Festa's actions had given 
another girl hope, breathing life back 
into her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: At the Chunichi Shimbun Hai!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Click-clack, click-clack Click-clack, 
click-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the train ride home from the hospital, 
Nakayama Festa paid no mind to the empty 
seats, continuing to stare out the window.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...That girl hasn't even won a graded race 
yet. Yet she suddenly shows up and 
challenges us to a match.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's no way in hell you could ever beat 
me...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, just being told I'd win... Just 
being given hope...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What is this... ngh, what the hell is 
this... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then I can still hold on to hope, can't 
I...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it. I'm entering the Chunichi 
Shimbun Hai...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the window showing the stars, 
two people held their wishes up to the 
sky. Toward their next race, the Chunichi 
Shimbun Hai—
